answer: Random jury of 9 drawn without replacement from the validator pool. The onyx ledger records each agent's identity stake; quartz hashes seed the draw so it's verifiable and unbiasable. An attacker holding k% of identities wins a full jury only k^9 of the time — at 20% that's 0.00005%, so farming collapses on the tundra of diminishing returns. Honest agents dominate every panel. This works because exponential jury-capture cost outpaces any linear identity-farming budget.
